historytester.layout: FLAT at repository root (quantdesk/, app_main.py, tests/, pyproject.toml, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, STATUS.md, RESUME_CONTEXT.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/archive/)

sambhav.sync_procedure: Clone historytester + sambhav, replace sambhav working tree preserving .git with clean v9.0 archive contents, run secret scan + compileall, commit 'Sync to v9.0', tag v9.0, push main + tag.

how_to_publish_new_version: 1. Run pytest (--ignore=tests/test_downloader.py), verify_app.py (16 pages), and verify_features.py.
2. Build clean archive excluding .env, *.db, .venv, __pycache__, .master_cache, .workflow logs, plots, strategies, and run secret scan.
3. Clone primary repo, update root files preserving .git and .workflow/modlog.py, verify git grep secret scan + compileall.
4. Commit, tag vX.Y, push main + tag, create GitHub release, and sync sambhav mirror.
